items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they didn’t care to know about people like Hank Mancini and me in the late 50s

ctx.x: Did not. The guys like Alex North, David Raksin, Hugo Friedhofer, they were very enthusiastic, but the real old bunch – you know I was one of the interlopers, they didn’t care to know about people like Hank Mancini and me in the late 50s, --not yet.
The irony was that that same year was the year that Mancini started doing the, Peter Gunn, scores for television.
